$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: Checked and invalid states use shape/pattern and text in addition to color. Not color alone.
Radio button outlines and focus rings have adequate contrast in light and dark modes. All control boundaries clearly distinguishable.
Visible text matches screen reader announcements in all stories: Default, Checked, Free, description text, and error message.
All text fully visible and readable in all screenshots. No truncation or overlapping.
Blue focus ring is bright, prominent, and obviously visible around focused radio button in all three focused stories.
